verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a first-party parse-documents capability that converts PDFs, Office documents, and spreadsheets into Markdown, with optional OCR for scanned PDFs. That covers text extraction across the story's file types as a hosted API. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of direct file upload (versus URL-only input, which bears on the 'without hosting them myself' part), explicit naming of Word and PowerPoint formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract text content from PDFs, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without hosting them myself

citations.quote: Convert PDFs, Office documents, spreadsheets, and other files into Markdown. Recover scanned PDF pages with optional OCR.
